unit_description: This unit introduces perimeter as the distance around a shape. Students find perimeter on grids, calculate the perimeter of rectangles and quadrilaterals, and find missing side lengths and solve perimeter problems.
unit_goals: Understand perimeter as the distance around a shape.
Find the perimeter of rectangles and quadrilaterals.
Find missing side lengths and solve perimeter problems.
Use addition and multiplication to find perimeter.

weeks.weekly_focus: Students learn to measure the distance around shapes, find perimeter on grids, and solve perimeter problems with missing sides.

lessons.lesson_title: Perimeter as Distance Around a Shape
lessons.fact_drill: Warm up by tracing the edges of different shapes.
lessons.concept: Perimeter is the total distance around the outside of a shape. To find it, add the lengths of all the sides.
lessons.practice: Find the perimeter of shapes by adding side lengths.
lessons.objective: Understand perimeter as the distance around a shape.

warmup.title: Luma Charge
warmup.instructions: Warm up by thinking about distance around.

questions.prompt: A triangle has sides 3, 4, and 5 units. What is the perimeter?
A square has sides of 6. What is the perimeter?

learn.title: Perimeter as Distance Around a Shape
teaching_points: Perimeter is the outside distance of a shape.
For a square, multiply one side by 4.

example.prompt: Find the perimeter of a rectangle with sides 5, 3, 5, and 3.

try_it.title: Try one together
try_it.prompt: A quadrilateral has sides 7, 4, 7, and 4. What is the perimeter?

practice_block.title: Practice Time
practice_block.instructions: Add all the side lengths to find the perimeter.

bigIdea.title: Perimeter as Distance Around a Shape
bigIdea.subtitle: Add all the sides
bigIdea.intro: Perimeter is the distance you would walk if you went all the way around a shape. To find it, add every side length.
bigIdea.bigQuestion: How is perimeter different from area?

ruleCards.description: Perimeter is the total distance around a shape.
Every side length must be included.

lessons.fact_drill: Warm up by counting unit lengths around shapes on a grid.
lessons.concept: On a grid, each side of a square unit is 1 unit long. Count the unit segments around the shape to find the perimeter.
lessons.practice: Find the perimeter of shapes drawn on grids by counting unit lengths.

warmup.title: Luma Charge
warmup.instructions: Warm up by counting on a grid.

questions.prompt: A 3 by 3 square on a grid has how many units around it?
A rectangle 4 units long and 2 units wide has a perimeter of how many units?
Count the unit segments around an L-shaped figure with sides 6, 2, 3, 2, 6, and 5.

learn.title: Find Perimeter on Grids
teaching_points: Count the unit segments around the shape.

example.prompt: Find the perimeter of a 5 by 4 rectangle on a grid.

try_it.title: Try one together
try_it.prompt: Find the perimeter of a 6 by 3 rectangle on a grid.

practice_block.title: Practice Time
practice_block.instructions: Count the unit segments around each shape on the grid.

bigIdea.title: Find Perimeter on Grids
bigIdea.subtitle: Count unit segments
bigIdea.intro: On a grid, the perimeter is the number of unit segments around the shape. Count each side carefully, even if it is short.
bigIdea.bigQuestion: Why is it helpful to find perimeter on a grid?

ruleCards.equation: each side of a square = 1 unit
ruleCards.description: Count the unit segments around the shape.
Add every side, even for irregular shapes.

lessons.lesson_title: Find the Perimeter of Rectangles and Quadrilaterals
lessons.fact_drill: Warm up by adding pairs of sides and doubling.
lessons.concept: For a rectangle, opposite sides are equal. Perimeter can be found by adding length + width + length + width, or 2 × length + 2 × width. For any quadrilateral, add all four sides.
lessons.practice: Find the perimeter of rectangles and other quadrilaterals using formulas and addition.
lessons.objective: Find the perimeter of rectangles and quadrilaterals.

questions.prompt: A rectangle has length 8 and width 5. What is the perimeter?
A rectangle has length 10 and width 4. Use 2 × length + 2 × width.
A quadrilateral has sides 9, 6, 7, and 4. What is the perimeter?

learn.title: Find the Perimeter of Rectangles and Quadrilaterals
teaching_points: Rectangles have two pairs of equal sides.

example.prompt: Find the perimeter of a rectangle with length 7 and width 4.

try_it.title: Try one together
try_it.prompt: Find the perimeter of a rectangle with length 9 and width 6.

practice_block.title: Practice Time
practice_block.instructions: Find the perimeter of each rectangle or quadrilateral.

flashcards.title: Rectangle Perimeter
flashcards.instructions: Review perimeter of rectangles and quadrilaterals.

bigIdea.title: Find the Perimeter of Rectangles and Quadrilaterals
bigIdea.subtitle: Use a formula for rectangles
bigIdea.intro: For a rectangle, opposite sides are equal. You can add all four sides or use a shortcut: 2 × length + 2 × width.
bigIdea.bigQuestion: Why does 2 × length + 2 × width work for a rectangle?

ruleCards.description: Two lengths plus two widths gives the perimeter.

lessons.lesson_title: Find Missing Side Lengths and Solve Perimeter Problems
lessons.fact_drill: Warm up by subtracting known sides from a given perimeter.
lessons.concept: If you know the perimeter and some side lengths, subtract the known sides from the perimeter to find the missing side. For rectangles, opposite sides are equal.
lessons.practice: Find missing side lengths and solve perimeter word problems.
lessons.objective: Find missing side lengths and solve perimeter problems.

questions.prompt: A rectangle has perimeter 20 and length 6. What is the width?
A triangle has perimeter 18. Two sides are 7 and 6. What is the third side?
A quadrilateral has perimeter 30. Three sides are 8, 7, and 9. What is the fourth side?

learn.title: Find Missing Side Lengths and Solve Perimeter Problems
teaching_points: Perimeter is the total of all sides.
Subtract the known sides from the perimeter.

example.prompt: A rectangle has perimeter 24 and length 8. Find the width.

try_it.title: Try one together
try_it.prompt: A rectangle has perimeter 28 and width 5. What is the length?

practice_block.title: Practice Time
practice_block.instructions: Find the missing side length for each perimeter problem.

flashcards.title: Missing Sides and Perimeter
flashcards.instructions: Review finding missing sides using perimeter.

bigIdea.title: Find Missing Side Lengths and Solve Perimeter Problems
bigIdea.subtitle: Subtract the known sides
bigIdea.intro: If you know the total perimeter and all but one side, subtract the known sides from the total. For rectangles, remember opposite sides are equal.
bigIdea.bigQuestion: How do you find a missing side when you know the perimeter?

ruleCards.description: Use the total perimeter and the known sides.
Subtract the known sides to find the remaining total.

lessons.fact_drill: Rapid review of perimeter as distance around, perimeter on grids, rectangles and quadrilaterals, and missing side lengths.
lessons.concept: Review the four big ideas from this unit: perimeter as the distance around a shape, perimeter on grids, perimeter of rectangles and quadrilaterals, and finding missing side lengths.
lessons.practice: Complete a balanced evaluation covering the skills from this unit.
lessons.objective: Show what you know about perimeter.

warmup.title: Luma Charge
warmup.instructions: Get ready to show what you know.

questions.prompt: A rectangle is 7 by 5. What is the perimeter?
A square has perimeter 36. What is the side length?
A shape on a grid has sides 6, 4, 6, and 4. What is the perimeter?

learn.title: Ready to Show What You Know
teaching_points: Use any strategy that helps you.

example.prompt: You have learned four big ideas this unit.
example.equation: perimeter as distance + grids + rectangles/quadrilaterals + missing sides = perimeter

try_it.title: Try one together
try_it.prompt: A rectangle has length 10 and width 3. What is the perimeter?

practice_block.title: Unit Evaluation
practice_block.instructions: Answer all questions carefully to show your understanding.

flashcards.title: Unit 23 Review
flashcards.instructions: Review key terms from Unit 23 before the evaluation.

bigIdea.title: Unit Evaluation: Perimeter
bigIdea.subtitle: Show what you know
bigIdea.intro: This evaluation checks your understanding of the four big ideas from this unit: perimeter as distance around, perimeter on grids, perimeter of rectangles and quadrilaterals, and missing side lengths.
bigIdea.bigQuestion: What do you know about perimeter?

ruleCards.description: Add every side length to find the perimeter.
Subtract known sides from the perimeter to find missing sides.
